title: Thu 12 Nov 2026: AI rally lifts Wall Street, Nvidia slides on CEO ouster report, UK GDP due, Financial Services Bill heads to committee
summary: Wall Street and Europe's STOXX 600 rally on AI optimism before Nvidia shares tumble after hours on a report its board is preparing to remove Jensen Huang. We preview this morning's UK growth figures, a hawkish Bank of England deputy governor and a near-certain Fed rise in December, then look at the Financial Services and Markets Bill entering committee with a call for written evidence, reports the FCA may revisit its retail crypto derivatives ban, and private markets fundraising. Plus three COO action points and the diary.
